_meta.selection: approved creature-type hierarchy; candidate specializations remain source-only

entries.name: Creature types and inherited defaults
entries.description: One selected, edition-independent creature-type hierarchy for new native creature definitions; existing reviewed monster statistics are not recomputed automatically.

genericParent.name: Creature
genericParent.description: Universal creature mechanics. No arbitrary ability score, speed, Hit Die count, or fixed Hit Die size.

inheritance.model: Generic Creature parent; typed descendants may inherit and override properties. Creature families and individual definitions can be further descendants.
inheritance.classification: Mechanical inheritance and type-sensitive targeting identity are distinct. Explicit effective type eligibility controls targeting; do not infer every ancestor or shared mixin as a target type.
inheritance.typeEligibilityResolution: Deferred until multi-type targeting rules are finalized; no automatic change to existing creature targeting eligibility.
inheritance.existingStatblocks: Keep previously reconciled 5.x statistics and effective traits intact during migration; explicit creature overrides preserve differences.
inheritance.strengths: Fortitude, Reflex, and Will are separate native saving throws from Constitution, Dexterity, and Wisdom; type defaults establish competency, not a numerical formula.
inheritance.sharedTraits: Store common properties at the appropriate ancestor; leave more specific or exceptional traits to descendants.

unresolved: Historical BAB and saving throw numerical progressions
Automatic CR/HD scaling or monster advancement
Additional historical immunities that depend on unreconciled combat rules

entries.name: Outsider
entries.description: Planar or otherworldly foundation; breathing follows generic Creature default.

entries.name: Celestial
entries.description: Further shared celestial traits belong to more specialized descendants.

entries.name: Fiend
entries.description: Further shared fiend traits belong to more specialized descendants.

entries.name: Elemental

savingThrowDefaults.note: Elemental strong-save defaults are supplied by specific elemental descendants, where appropriate.

entries.description: Elemental nature; elemental-body physiology is not universal to genies and other Elementals.

entries.name: Fey
entries.description: Overrides Outsider biological requirements; other Fey-specific characteristics are inherited further down.

entries.name: True Elemental
entries.description: Additional elemental-body properties are assigned here or to a more specific descendant after trait review.

entries.name: Beast
entries.description: Ordinary biological needs; no universal intelligence, language, alignment, or equipment prohibitions.

entries.name: Magical Beast
entries.description: Additional Darkvision supplements inherited Low-Light Vision. Magical Beast does not imply magical attacks or mandatory spellcasting.

entries.name: Vermin
entries.description: Invertebrate foundation. Mindless is not universal; families grant it explicitly where appropriate.

entries.name: Humanoid
entries.description: Ordinary physiology, equipment compatibility; no universal language, armor, speed, alignment, or ability scores.

entries.name: Giant
entries.description: No mandatory Large size or uniform Strength. Humanoid mechanical ancestry does not automatically settle Humanoid spell-target eligibility.

entries.name: Monstrosity
entries.description: Broad monstrous physiology; no blanket senses, immunities, or magical abilities.

entries.name: Monstrous Humanoid
entries.description: Monstrous creature with humanoid-like anatomy; does not automatically acquire Humanoid targeting eligibility.

entries.name: Aberration
entries.description: Unusual anatomy; no automatic psionics, telepathy, or magical resistance.

entries.name: Construct
entries.description: Constitution scores and native healing remain possible; additional historical construct immunities are not automatically operative.

entries.name: Dragon
entries.description: Breath weapons, flight, frightful presence, and elemental immunity belong to descendants where appropriate.

entries.name: Ooze
entries.description: Amorphous foundation; no universal Mindless, critical-hit immunity, or mandatory single blindsight range.

entries.name: Plant
entries.description: Game classification includes fungal creatures; no assertion that fungi are botanically plants.

entries.name: Undead
entries.description: Retains Constitution scores; does not universally import 3.x critical-hit, mental-effect, or energy-drain rules.
